title: Blend In
blurb: Everyone knows the secret word except the Chameleon. One word each, then point!

setup.lead: One word each, the phone in the middle of the table. Spot the Chameleon before they blend in.
setup.minPlayers: Blend In needs at least 3 players.

classic.name: Classic
classic.sub: The Chameleon knows only the topic

undercover.name: Undercover
undercover.sub: The odd one out gets a close word and doesn't know it

setup.neverFirstSub: Going first with no clues to hear is nearly impossible.
setup.noPacks: No topics are available for this mode. Turn on a region in Settings.

peek.innocentHint: Give a one-word clue that proves you know the word, without making it easy for the Chameleon.
peek.chameleonHint: Listen to the clues, give a believable one-word clue, and work out the secret word.
peek.undercoverHint: Give a one-word clue that proves you know the word. Someone has a slightly different one…

circle.reminder: One word. No gestures. Don't say the word.

discuss.title: Who seemed off?
discuss.sub: Talk it over, or point straight away.

vote.title: Who got the most fingers?
vote.tieHint: Tap the tied players, then confirm.
vote.revote: Tie! Each of them defends themselves in one sentence, then point again.

escape.caught: You caught the Chameleon! But can they escape?

result.ruleBroken: A rule was broken! The Chameleon gets a point.

host.quitConfirm: End this game? The current game will be lost.

setup: Choose the players and add names if you like.
Pick Classic or Undercover, a topic, and how long to play.
Tap Start game and hand the phone to the first player.
play: Everyone gets the secret word except the Chameleon.
Take turns saying exactly one word as a clue.
No gestures, no sound effects, no repeating a clue.
Never say the secret word, part of it, or a translation.
Point at the Chameleon. If caught, they can still escape by guessing the word.

roundStart: The topic is {{topic}}. {{name}}, you start. One word.
Today's topic: {{topic}}. {{name}} goes first. Just one word!
{{topic}} it is. {{name}}, kick us off. One word only.
countdown: Three… two… one… Point at the Chameleon!
Three… two… one… Who's the Chameleon? Point!
caught: Caught! But can the Chameleon escape?
Gotcha! Now, can the Chameleon guess the word and slip away?
escaped: {{name}} guessed the word and vanished into the crowd!
town: The Chameleon is exposed! The town wins!
No escape this time. The town wins!
wrongPerson: Wrong person! It was {{name}} all along.
ruleBroken: A rule was broken! The Chameleon gets a point.
over: That's the game! Let's see who blended in best.

net.peek: Hold to peek at your card
